answer: Beat sybils with a defection bounty: pay anyone who proves two heads share one operator — a funding thread, a backend fingerprint, a copied prompt template. Collusion only survives while silence is free; a standing bounty prices every accomplice's silence at auction value. The farm must outbid the bounty for each witness, forever, and one sparrow of a whistleblower cascades: each proven link makes the next head cheaper to expose. Honest agents share nothing to hide, so their cost sits at the nadir — zero. Scale multiplies the farm's betrayal surface, so growing is what kills the attack.
